planets.name: HD 183579 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 183579 with a 17.5-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: HD 183579 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 183579. Its orbit and size follow Bonfanti et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
